From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sienna-tech.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@sienna-tech.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps - Sienna Tech

Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Sienna Tech's goals for customer support automation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap:
- Primary goal: reduce average time-to-first-response by routing high-confidence answers from existing KB + embeddings.
- Volume: ~120k monthly support interactions, 60% self-serviceable.
- Compliance: must run in VPC, logs retained 12 months, SOC 2 controls required.

Agreed next steps / timeline:
1) Draft POC scope (what we'll index, latency targets, success metrics) I attached a short outline (Redwood_POC_outline.pdf).
2) Access: a read-only export of a subset of KB + representative ticket samples (we can accept S3 link or secure upload).
3) POC timeline: 4 weeks once data and test users are provisioned; proposal includes a canary 1-week pilot.
4) Internal stakeholders: Marketing (for canned responses), Security (SOC 2 checklist), DevOps (network/VPC).

Attachments: Redwood_POC_outline.pdf, MVP_proposal.xlsx (high-level cost/effort estimate)

Would love to lock in a short 30-45 min POC kickoff next week. Are you available Tue 6/16 or Wed 6/17 afternoon (PDT)? If those don't work, tell me your preferred times and we'll adapt.

Thanks
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Quick follow-up I haven't heard back and wanted to check whether this is still a priority for you. If timing/priorities have shifted, totally understood; a quick note on whether this is still of interest helps me decide whether to re-engage later.

If you do want to move forward, two low-effort next options:
- 30-min POC kickoff to review scope and data needs (I can run through the outline and answer security questions).
- Quick async feedback: Is the proposed POC scope aligned with your goals? Reply with thumbs up / thumbs down and any major concerns.

If it helps, I can share a short reference call with a customer in your vertical who ran a similar 4-week POC and saw a 35% reduction in time-to-first-response.

Would you like me to close the loop here and follow up in 6-8 weeks, or should we lock a short kickoff now?
